question: Q-N-S2-D4
text: Card tips by payment type for 2024. Expected: a value only for payment type 1; NULL for all others.
interpretation: Card tips by payment type for 2024: a value for payment type 1 only; NULL for every other type, including types with no 2024 trips (all codes of dim_payment_type are listed).
assemble: SELECT c.payment_type, c.payment_type_name, q.card_tips FROM codes c LEFT JOIN q ON q.payment_type = c.payment_type AND q.trips > 0 ORDER BY c.payment_type
note: The member list is the Payment Type table's domain (dimension-only query), so codes without 2024 trips appear with blank card tips, as the oracle requires.
